notes: VA LOI TOOL DUNG RAT LAU / NHU TREO o buoc Transcription (Whisper) - port tu Phong_ADung v22.100.19/20. Do that tren may nay (Xeon E5-2673 v3, 48 logical CPU, video 30s, model small): ban cu 145-172s roi tien trinh CHET. BON nguyen nhan doc lap: (1) NAP MODEL CHO MANG: faster-whisper kiem tra huggingface.co moi lan nap; 172s khi con cho mang, chi 3.4s khi HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1. Da ep offline tu DAU file VA trong _WHISPER_CHILD (phai dat TRUOC khi import faster_whisper - huggingface_hub chi doc bien luc import). (2) BIEN MOI TRUONG LAM CHAM 4-5 LAN: ban cu dat OMP/MKL/OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 (ca o dau file lan trong child). Do that: khong dat gi -> 28s; OPENBLAS=2 -> 106s; OMP=2 -> 145s. Da bo han, dieu khien so thread bang cpu_threads cua WhisperModel (max(4, min(12, cpu_total//4))). (3) PyAV KHONG KHOP: fw 1.2.1 goi av.open(metadata_errors=...) ma PyAV 19 khong nhan -> TypeError. Da luon xuat WAV 16k mono (skip_audio_extract=False) roi doc bang thu vien `wave` va DUA MANG numpy cho transcribe() - khong con cham tới PyAV. (4) VAD LAM SEGFAULT: vad_filter=True nap onnxruntime, ma onnxruntime tren may nay no access violation ngay khi import. Da tat VAD. NGOAI RA: khoa ctranslate2==4.6.0 trong ensure_packages() (4.6.1-4.8.2 crash native khi nap model; faster-whisper chi doi 'ctranslate2<5,>=4.0' nen pip se keo ve ban crash neu cai lai) + setuptools<81 (ct2 4.6.0 can pkg_resources). Da test _WHISPER_CHILD doc lap: exit 0, 3 doan, khong crash.
